issues.title: Site pooling uses a fixed site list
issues.summary: The specification lists pooled sites instead of expressing the SAP pooling algorithm.
issues.expected: Pool small sites by treatment-group counts, repeat pooling when needed, and break ties as the SAP specifies.
issues.observed: The specification maps seven fixed site IDs to 900; it states no repeat-pooling or tie-break rule.
issues.action: Replace the fixed list with the documented algorithm, or document and justify the fixed assignment.

citations.quote: Sites that enroll fewer than 3 patients in any one treatment group will be grouped together
then this group of patients will be combined with the next fewest enrolling site
In the event that there is a tie for fewest-enrolling site, one of these will be chosen at random by a random-number generator.

issues.title: First-dose date uses a different source
issues.summary: Define-XML names the Visit 3 date; the specification reads the earliest exposure start date.
issues.expected: Use SV.SVSTDTC at SV.VISITNUM=3, as Define-XML states.
issues.observed: The specification uses MIN(EX.EXSTDTC).
issues.action: Confirm the intended source and align the specification and documentation.

citations.quote: the date of first dose [Week 0 (Visit 3) unless indicated otherwise]

issues.title: First-dose date imputation is undocumented
issues.summary: The specification completes partial dates to January and day 1 without a documented rule.
issues.expected: Any partial-date completion needs an explicit rule for ADSL.TRTSDT.
issues.observed: The specification sets missing month and day components to 1.
issues.action: Document the intended imputation policy or remove the unsupported completion.

issues.title: Last-dose fallback omits a condition
issues.summary: The specification uses the discontinuation date without checking discontinuation after Visit 3.
issues.expected: Use the discontinuation date only when the last dose date is missing and discontinuation occurred after Visit 3.
issues.observed: The fallback is used whenever the final exposure end date is missing.
issues.action: Add the documented condition or clarify why a broader fallback is intended.

citations.quote: and the subject discontinued after visit 3

issues.title: Last-dose date imputation is undocumented
issues.summary: Partial last-dose and fallback dates are completed without a documented ADSL policy.
issues.expected: Document how partial last-dose and discontinuation dates should be completed.
issues.observed: Both branches fill missing month and day components with 1.
issues.action: Confirm and document the imputation policy, or remove the unsupported completion.

issues.title: Zero-duration guard needs no separate rule
issues.summary: The check flags NULLIF(TRTDUR, 0), but the adjudicator disputes that it changes the documented division.
issues.expected: CUMDOSE/TRTDUR has no value when duration is zero.
issues.observed: NULLIF makes the missing result explicit; the adjudicator considers the behavior equivalent.
issues.action: Resolve the disputed check before treating this as a documentation gap.

issues.title: Cumulative dose uses exposure records
issues.summary: The documented computation uses planned doses and visit intervals; the specification sums recorded exposure.
issues.expected: Apply the Define-XML planned-dose formula, including its high-dose titration intervals.
issues.observed: The specification sums EX.EXDOSE over exposure days.
issues.action: Agree the intended calculation and align Define-XML and the specification.

citations.quote: 54mg per day for the # of days subj was in 1st dosing interval

issues.title: Open-ended exposure is extended without a rule
issues.summary: An exposure record without an end date is extended to TRTEDT without documented support.
issues.expected: State how a final exposure record with a missing end date contributes to cumulative dose.
issues.observed: The specification adds dose through TRTEDT for the open-ended record.
issues.action: Document the extension rule or revise the computation.

issues.title: Age grouping order is disputed
issues.summary: The specification derives the character and numeric groups in the reverse order to Define-XML.
issues.expected: Apply the documented age cutpoints and pair each character group with its numeric code.
issues.observed: The adjudicator considers the reversed calculation order to express the same logic.
issues.action: Resolve the disputed equivalence before requiring a specification change.

issues.title: Race mapping omits ASIAN
issues.summary: The codelist assigns ASIAN to 7, but the specification has no ASIAN mapping.
issues.expected: Map ASIAN to RACEN=7, as the published codelist states.
issues.observed: An ASIAN input would produce a missing RACEN.
issues.action: Add the documented mapping and verify the currently unrepresented category.

issues.title: Completer definitions disagree on population
issues.summary: The SAP restricts completers to the efficacy population; Define-XML does not.
issues.expected: Choose one definition of Week 24 completers, including whether EFFFL must be Y.
issues.observed: The specification follows Define-XML without the SAP efficacy-population restriction.
issues.action: Confirm the intended population and align the SAP, Define-XML and specification.

citations.quote: Y if subject has a SV.VISITNUM=12 and ENDDT>= date of visit 12
All patients in the efficacy population who completed their Week 24 visit (Visit 12).

issues.title: BMI formula uses the wrong height conversion
issues.summary: Define-XML multiplies height by 100; the specification divides by 100 to convert centimetres to metres.
issues.expected: The published formula is WEIGHTBL / ((HEIGHTBL*100)**2).
issues.observed: The written formula differs from 253 reference records; dividing height by 100 reproduces all 254.
issues.action: Confirm the intended units and correct the published formula if the metre conversion is intended.

issues.title: Obese category code differs from the codelist
issues.summary: The codelist codes the obese group as >30 while reference and output use >=30; the documented numeric cutoff agrees.
issues.expected: Use the same coded category in the codelist and output for the documented BMI >=30 group.
issues.observed: The reference and output contain 28 >=30 values outside the published codelist. The numerical-boundary contradiction checks are disputed.
issues.action: Align the obese category code while preserving the documented numeric boundary.

issues.title: Missing BMI is assigned to the normal group
issues.summary: One subject without baseline BMI receives <25; the documented rule leaves the group missing.
issues.expected: Leave BMIBLGR1 missing when BMIBL is missing, as the documented rule states.
issues.observed: The specification and reference assign <25 to subject 01-702-1082.
issues.action: Confirm missing-BMI handling and align the rule, specification and reference through a separate review.

citations.quote: Missing baseline values and missing safety data will not be imputed

issues.title: Baseline height has no Visit 1 restriction
issues.summary: The specification can select a later height when Visit 1 height is unavailable.
issues.expected: Use a HEIGHT measurement at VISITNUM=1.
issues.observed: The specification keeps the earliest HEIGHT record without restricting the visit.
issues.action: Add the documented Visit 1 restriction or clarify the intended fallback.

issues.title: Baseline weight uses the baseline flag
issues.summary: The specification selects VSBLFL=Y instead of explicitly selecting Visit 3.
issues.expected: Use a WEIGHT measurement at VISITNUM=3.
issues.observed: The specification filters on the baseline flag, which can select a different visit.
issues.action: Confirm whether the baseline flag or Visit 3 defines the intended record.

issues.title: Documented education test code is absent
issues.summary: Define-XML names YEARSEDU; staged SC records and the specification use EDLEVEL.
issues.expected: The documented test code must identify the education records used to derive EDUCLVL.
issues.observed: YEARSEDU matches no education records; EDLEVEL reproduces all 254 reference values.
issues.action: Confirm EDLEVEL as the intended source code and correct the documentation.

issues.title: Disease-duration calculation is unspecified
issues.summary: Documents state months without a conversion or day-count rule; the specification uses inclusive days divided by 30.4375.
issues.expected: State the month conversion, day counting and precision explicitly.
issues.observed: The specification counts both endpoints and divides by 30.4375. The literal documented calculation remains unprobed.
issues.action: Confirm and document the complete disease-duration calculation before assessing literal agreement.

issues.title: Completion term is misspelled in Define-XML
issues.summary: The documented filter uses PROTCOL COMPLETED, which matches no disposition record.
issues.expected: Use the retained disposition term PROTOCOL COMPLETED when referring to completion records.
issues.observed: The literal rule differs on 254 records; fixing the spelling alone still leaves 144 differences.
issues.action: Correct the term separately from the incomplete early-termination rule.

issues.title: Completion-only rule omits early terminations
issues.summary: The derivation comment excludes early terminations that the label, SAP and specification include.
issues.expected: Define end of treatment for completers and early terminations, on or before the Week 24 visit.
issues.observed: Correcting the spelling leaves 144 reference differences; the on-or-before-Week-24 reading reproduces all 254.
issues.action: Rewrite the derivation comment to cover early terminations and the Week 24 limit.

issues.title: MMSE total uses a different result variable

issues.expected: State whether the total uses original or standardized numeric results.
issues.observed: The specification sums QS.QSSTRESN rather than QS.QSORRES.

issues.title: MMSE original-result conversion is unspecified
issues.summary: The literal original-result sum needs numeric handling for nonnumeric QSORRES text; standardized results cannot substitute for that source.
issues.expected: Specify which original results are included and how nonnumeric text is handled.
issues.observed: The literal QSORRES rule remains unprobed; explicit conversion readings are retained only as diagnostics.
issues.action: Clarify the original-result scope and conversion policy before accepting a literal comparison.

issues.title: MMSE aggregation has no baseline selection
issues.summary: The SAP describes the MMSE covariate as baseline disease severity; the specification aggregates MMSE records without an assessment-time condition.
issues.expected: State which assessment time or visit defines the baseline MMSE covariate.
issues.observed: The specification filters the questionnaire category but does not restrict visit or assessment time.
issues.action: Confirm and document the baseline assessment selection and align the aggregation.
